mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE > 5.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) below 2% annualized for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98 for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO < 98 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 145,000 for three consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS > 145000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the housing market (HOUST) below 1,100 for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced spending, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST < 1100 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in personal savings (RSAFS) above 459,000 for three consecutive months signals increased precautionary savings and reduced consumer spending, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS > 459000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
